描述_EN: produced in 2001, the set contains pieces of work by artists sarah charlesworth, barbara kruger, allan mccollum, lisa yuskavage, alexander ross, and john newman. this miniature art collection was designed and manufactured to accompany the kaleidoscope dolls' house, designed by artist laurie simmons and architect peter wheelwright.
描述_ZN: 2001年生产的，这套作品包含了艺术家Sarah Charlesworth、Barbara Kruger、Allan McCollum、Lisa Yuskavage、Alexander Ross和John Newman的作品。 这个微型艺术系列的设计和制造是为了配合万花筒娃娃屋，由艺术家劳瑞-西蒙斯和建筑师彼得-沃莱特设计。
